The Company engages in trust and wealth management services through Wye  Trust, a division of Shore United Bank, N.A., and also offers securities and  advisory services through broker-dealer LPL Financial, doing business as Wye  Financial Partners. <DIV><FONT size="1" style="font-size:1pt;color:white">#006881 #ACC0C6 #83AFB4 #FEBE10 #5F574F #4D4F53 #C75B12 #5B8F22 #593160 Non-GAAP&nbsp;Reconciliation &#8216;&#8216;Efficiency ratio&#8221; is defined as recurring noninterest expense less foreclosed real estate (&quot;OREO&quot;) expenses and valuation allowances, less merger and acquisition costs, less amortization of intangible assets  divided by operating revenue. Operating revenue is equal to net interest income plus noninterest income excluding gains and losses on securities, foreclosed real estate and sales of impaired loans. In our  judgment, the adjustments made to noninterest expense and operating revenue allow investors and analysts to better assess our operating expenses in relation to our core operating revenue by removing the  volatility that is associated with certain one-time items and other discrete items that are unrelated to our core business. &#8220;Efficiency ratio&#8221; is defined as noninterest expense divided by operating revenue. This is  the ratio that appears in the Company&#8217;s SEC filings. <DIV style="padding-top:2em;">

<DIV><FONT size="1" style="font-size:1pt;color:white">#006881 #ACC0C6 #83AFB4 #FEBE10 #5F574F #4D4F53 #C75B12 #5B8F22 #593160 Non-GAAP&nbsp;Reconciliation &#8220;Tangible common equity&#8221; (or &#8220;TCE&#8221;) is defined as stockholders&#8217; equity less preferred equity and intangible assets. &#8220;Tangible assets&#8221; (or &#8220;TA&#8221;) are defined as total assets less intangible assets. We believe that  the TCE/TA, the Return on Average Tangible Common Equity (&#8220;ROATCE&#8221;) and the adjusted ROATCE ratios are important to many investors in the marketplace who are interested in changes from period to  period exclusive of changes in preferred equity and intangible assets. Our calculation of adjusted ROATCE excludes the amortization of core deposits and merger costs.
